body:
Connect the published Kirshner--Samorodnitsky homogeneous moment bound with exact low-low Walsh block cancellation. The candidate proves critical-budget spectral rigidity whenever the order of exact uniform weighting-law marginals is a positive linear fraction of dimension, with no uniform-integrability or supercritical-moment hypothesis.

Use the published strict deficit on a fixed compact degree interval, handle the upper half of Walsh degrees by parity, sum homogeneous levels, then apply the signed Holder bilinear bound. Twelve adverse checks are fixed in the source. This closes the linear-fraction question left by319; it does not settle the intervening sublinear threshold. The earlier weaker321A interpolation calculation and draft321B are preserved in D. Group with319 in one manuscript, not a separate corollary paper. No local computation, formal proof, exact-PDF assessment, external priority or independent review is claimed; terminal source audit and required CI remain pending.
